title: John Harbaugh emphasizes resilience, discusses firing at alma mater's commencement speech

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: John Harbaugh emphasizes resilience, discusses firing at alma mater's commencement speech
sources.description: John Harbaugh gave the commencement speech at his alma mater over the weekend, and he used his own recent firing to illustrate a point about resilience.
